title: Big Data Initiative And Privacy
definition: Big Data refers to datasets characterized by extreme volume, velocity, variety, veracity, and value that require advanced computational architectures for processing, while privacy entails the governance of personal data collection, processing, storage, and cross-border flows under strict legal frameworks.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Civil Services GS Paper III (Science & Technology - IT, Cyber Security, AI, Governance) and GS Paper II (Polity & Constitution - Right to Privacy, State Surveillance, Digital Governance). Frequently tested in Prelims via institutional mechanisms and Mains via ethical dilemmas of data monetization vs. citizen privacy.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Big Data Initiative And Privacy.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of computer networks, cloud computing, and database management systems
